feed_summary: Researchers tie PHP2Shell attempts to a Mirai botnet and show an ASLR bypass, but no successful compromise has been confirmed yet. The post Mirai Botnet Operators Join PHP2Shell Attacks as ASLR Bypass Exploits Emerge appeared first on SecurityWeek .
title: Mirai Botnet Operators Join PHP2Shell Attacks as ASLR Bypass Exploits Emerge
